# Day Of Week

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DayOfWeek`](gmeow-DayOfWeek.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DayOfWeek>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A day of the week — a VALUE vocabulary (the seven ISO-8601 days as individuals); projects to [schema:dayOfWeek.](https://schema.org/dayOfWeek.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DayOfWeek`](gmeow-DayOfWeek.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for days of the week — the seven ISO-8601 days as individuals, referenced through [`gmeow:openingDay`](../properties/gmeow-openingDay.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-day subclasses (the days are individuals) and avoid a free-text day name; the seven seeded individuals are closed and complete.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded [`gmeow:dayMonday`](../individuals/gmeow-dayMonday.md) … [`gmeow:daySunday`](../individuals/gmeow-daySunday.md) individuals from a [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) via [`gmeow:openingDay`](../properties/gmeow-openingDay.md); the set is closed, so do not extend it.

### Examples

- ex:window [`gmeow:openingDay`](../properties/gmeow-openingDay.md) [`gmeow:dayMonday`](../individuals/gmeow-dayMonday.md), [`gmeow:dayTuesday`](../individuals/gmeow-dayTuesday.md).
